title: cyathea fragilis
intro: Cyathea fragilis, commonly known as the fragile tree fern, is a species of tree fern native to tropical and subtropical regions of Australia and New Guinea. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Cyathea fragilis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Cyathea fragilis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
